plain: Pair every YES item with every NO item and count how often the YES one got the higher score; that share is the AUC.
eli5: Line up every good apple against every bad apple and count how often the good one won.
technical: Wilcoxon–Mann–Whitney U divided by n<sub>1</sub>n<sub>2</sub> estimates P(X > Y) + ½P(X = Y), which equals the trapezoidal ROC area (Hanley and McNeil 1982).
